requirements.summary: Create the Pleiades TV app shell with a consistent visual theme across all pages (English-only UI text).
acceptanceCriteria: App name “Pleiades TV” is visible in the UI (e.g., header).
Theme is applied consistently (buttons, inputs, cards, typography).
All UI strings are in English.

file_operations.description: Add global styling (Tailwind layers, CSS variables, typography defaults) to establish a distinctive, consistent Pleiades TV theme across the app.
Adjust Tailwind theme tokens (colors/radii/shadows/typography) to match the Pleiades TV brand styling and ensure consistent component theming.
Create the root app shell (layout + top navigation + routed content area) and ensure all user-facing text is in English.
Create a layout wrapper to apply consistent spacing, backgrounds, and page structure across all screens.
Create a branded header that displays “Pleiades TV”, primary navigation, and auth controls (wired later).

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign in/out UI and expose authenticated principal state for gated actions.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in with Internet Identity and sign out.
UI clearly indicates signed-in vs signed-out state.
Authenticated principal is available to the rest of the app for gated actions (subscribe/comment/like).

file_operations.description: Implement a login/logout button using the `useInternetIdentity` hook and clear cached React Query data on logout. Use the selected `authorization` component guidance for authentication UI patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small signed-in/signed-out indicator (and principal short-form when signed in) for clear UI state.
Create a lightweight convenience hook that derives `isAuthenticated`, `principalTextShort`, and shared auth helpers from `useInternetIdentity`.

Wire LoginButton + AuthStatusBadge into the header so auth state is visible on all pages. Use the selected `authorization` component guidance for login/logout behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build VOD browse + video detail pages with playback, using backend catalog and detail retrieval, with loading/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page renders a grid/list of videos from the backend.
Clicking a video navigates to a detail view.
Detail view plays the video using the stored playback URL.
Loading and error states are shown for video fetches.

file_operations.description: Define client-side routes for browse (home), video detail (by video id), and account page, and export the router used by App.
Wire the router into the app shell so browse and video detail pages are navigable (including deep links for sharing).
Implement the browse page that fetches the video catalog via the backend actor and renders a grid/list with loading/error states.
Implement the video detail page that fetches video metadata by id, renders title/description, and hosts playback + engagement controls with loading/error states.
Add a React Query hook that calls the backend actor to fetch the video catalog and standardizes loading/error behavior.
Add a React Query hook that calls the backend actor to fetch a single video by id and standardizes loading/error behavior.
Create a reusable video card (thumbnail + title + optional duration) that links to the video detail route.
Create a reusable HTML5 video player wrapper that accepts a playback URL and supports disabled/blocked display for subscription gating.

requirements.summary: Implement subscription UI (subscribe/unsubscribe + status) and gate playback for non-subscribed users while keeping catalog browsing public.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores per-user subscription status and exposes methods to get status and toggle subscribe/unsubscribe.
Frontend shows a clear “Subscribe/Unsubscribe” control and current status.
Non-subscribed users can browse the catalog but attempting to play a video is blocked with a clear call-to-action to subscribe.
Subscribed users can play videos successfully.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook to fetch the current user's subscription status via the backend actor (enabled only when signed in) and provide loading/error state.
Add React Query mutations for subscribe/unsubscribe that update/invalidate subscription status queries for immediate UI consistency.
Create a Subscribe/Unsubscribe control that reflects current status, requires authentication, and triggers the appropriate backend calls.
Create a gate component for the video player area that blocks playback for non-subscribed users and shows a clear subscribe call-to-action while still showing metadata.
Wire subscription status + SubscribeButton + PlaybackSubscriptionGate into the detail page so non-subscribed users cannot play videos but can view metadata.
Add a prominent subscription status indicator and quick Subscribe/Unsubscribe access when signed in (without blocking public browsing).

requirements.summary: Implement video comments UI: list comments and allow authenticated users to post new comments with live update.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend supports adding a comment to a video and listing comments for a video in chronological order.
Frontend shows existing comments on the video detail page.
Signed-in users can submit a comment; signed-out users are prompted to sign in to comment.
Newly posted comments appear in the UI without a full page refresh.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook to fetch comments for a video and provide loading/error state.
Add a React Query mutation to post a comment and update/invalidate the comments query so new comments appear without a full refresh.
Create a comments section that displays comment list (author identifier + timestamp) and includes a comment form gated by authentication.

Create a controlled comment input and submit button; when signed out, show a sign-in prompt instead. Use selected `authorization` component guidance for authenticated UI behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire CommentsSection into the video detail page and ensure it reacts to video id changes.

requirements.summary: Implement likes UI: authenticated users can like/unlike a video, see like count, and preserve correct state after refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enforces at most one like per user per video and exposes like count + user’s like state.
Frontend displays like count and current user like state.
Toggling like updates the UI immediately and remains correct after refresh.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook to fetch like count for a video with loading/error state.
Add a React Query hook to derive the current user's like state for a video (enabled only when signed in) using available backend calls and cache strategy.
Add a mutation that toggles like/unlike and updates/invalidate like-related queries for immediate UI consistency.
Create a like button that shows current state + like count, requires authentication to toggle, and provides immediate UI feedback.
Wire LikeButton into the engagement controls area on the detail page.
Optionally display like count on browse cards (if available) without requiring authentication to view.

requirements.summary: Add sharing action on video detail page: Web Share API when available, otherwise copy share URL to clipboard with feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Video detail page has a Share action.
Copy-to-clipboard produces a shareable URL that includes the video id.
If Web Share API is supported, the app can invoke it; otherwise it gracefully falls back to copy-to-clipboard.
User receives visible feedback after copying/sharing.

file_operations.description: Implement a Share action that uses Web Share API when available and falls back to clipboard copy; show visible success/failure feedback.
Add helpers to construct a canonical shareable URL including the video id and to perform share/copy with consistent error handling.
Wire ShareButton into the engagement controls area and ensure it shares the current video id route URL.

requirements.summary: Add an account/subscription page for authenticated users showing principal short form and subscription status with management controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Account page is reachable from navigation when signed in.
Account page displays user identity info and subscription status.
Subscription can be managed from the account page.

file_operations.description: Create an account page that is accessible when signed in and displays principal short form plus subscription status with SubscribeButton.

Create an auth guard wrapper that blocks the account page for signed-out users with a clear sign-in prompt (without restricting public browsing). Use selected `authorization` component guidance for access-denied UI behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the account route and wrap it in RequireAuth so it is only reachable for authenticated users.
Add an Account navigation item that only appears when signed in.

requirements.summary: Add generated static image assets (branding + placeholders) under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
App uses the generated logo in the header/login area and uses placeholders where appropriate (e.g., missing thumbnails/avatars).

file_operations.description: Add the generated Pleiades TV logo mark at frontend/public/assets/generated/pleiades-tv-logo.dim_512x512.png and ensure it is committed as a static asset.
Add the generated hero/header background illustration at frontend/public/assets/generated/pleiades-hero.dim_1600x400.png and ensure it is committed as a static asset.
Add the generated video thumbnail placeholder at frontend/public/assets/generated/video-thumb-placeholder.dim_640x360.png and ensure it is committed as a static asset.
Add the generated avatar placeholder at frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-placeholder.dim_256x256.png and ensure it is committed as a static asset.
Render the generated logo in the header/login area using frontend/public/assets/generated/pleiades-tv-logo.dim_512x512.png and apply theme-consistent sizing/spacing.
Render the generated hero background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/pleiades-hero.dim_1600x400.png) within the existing browse page header section (no new top-level routes).
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/video-thumb-placeholder.dim_640x360.png when a video has a missing/empty thumbnail URL.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-placeholder.dim_256x256.png for comment author avatar placeholders where appropriate.
